newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim plans PLN 550 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim plans PLN 550 mln bond issue.

text.p: Polish industrial and trading conglomerate Elektrim SA plans to issue seven-year convertible bonds worth 550 million zlotys, the company said on Friday.
It said in a statement the decision on the issue would be taken at a shareholders' meeting on January 31.
The company also wanted to issue 19 million new shares ex rights to be exchanged for the bonds, with the 500,000 zlotys nominal value each, it said.
The bonds' issue price, currency in which they will be denominated and other terms of the issue will be determined by the management, it said.
The bonds could be exchanged for the shares no sooner than on the day the Securities Commission clears the new shares for the public trade and no later than on their redemption day.
The new shares' issue price will initially be equal to that on the Warsaw Stock Exchange plus no more than 15 percent.
